name: Human Gate
description: Pause flow execution for interactive human review, dynamic form input, approval, or draft editing (n8n style).

inputs.name: responseType
inputs.label: Response Medium / Channel
inputs.helpText: Choose whether human responses are collected via the Flow Studio execution panel or Telegram.

inputs.name: chatId
inputs.label: Telegram Chat ID / User ID
inputs.helpText: Target Telegram Chat ID or User ID to send the question to.

inputs.name: botToken
inputs.label: Telegram Bot Token (Optional)
inputs.placeholder: 123456:ABC-DEF... (Leave blank to use token configured in Settings)
inputs.helpText: Optional bot token override. Defaults to Telegram Bot Token configured in Settings.

inputs.name: question
inputs.label: Question / Prompt
inputs.defaultValue: Please review this request and provide your response.
inputs.helpText: Prompt or instructions displayed at the top of the human review dialog.

inputs.name: inputType
inputs.label: Input Component Type
inputs.helpText: Specifies the UI control rendered for the user when the flow reaches this gate.

inputs.name: options
inputs.label: Choice Options
inputs.helpText: List of options for Select or Radio component (e.g. ["Staging", "Production"]).

inputs.name: formFields
inputs.label: Custom Form Fields (JSON)
inputs.helpText: Array of field definitions for multi-field form mode.

inputs.name: draft
inputs.label: Draft to Review
inputs.helpText: Upstream content or artifact for the user to inspect (e.g. {{nodes.agent_1.result.summary}}).

inputs.name: allowDraftEdit
inputs.label: Allow User to Edit Draft Directly

options.label: Yes (User can edit draft before submitting)

inputs.helpText: When enabled, the user can modify the draft text in place, and the revised text will be emitted downstream.

inputs.name: timeoutMs
inputs.label: Timeout (ms)
inputs.helpText: Maximum wait time in milliseconds before timing out (default: 24 hours).
